chunks: Women are the snares of Satan.

key_terms.اَلشَّيْطَانِ: Satan; the tempter who leads people toward sin
key_terms.حِبَالَةُ: snare, trap, or means of entanglement

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "Women are the snares of Satan" mean?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a concise ethical warning using strong imagery, describing women as a means by which Shaytan may tempt people. Its significance lies in its admonitory tone within the genre of brief prophetic sayings, warning believers to remain vigilant against moral temptation.
